# Versions allowed into pnpm-lock.yaml before they are as old as pnpm-workspace.yaml's
# minimumReleaseAge (7 days). Read by scripts/check_lockfile_release_age.ts in CI (audit SUP-1).
#
# One `name@version` a line, then why and who decided, for example:
#   hono@4.13.16  security fix for GHSA-xxxx, the operator decided 2026-11-20
#
# Keep it empty. A line here is the one way past the week, and it is a reviewed commit of its own;
# remove it once the version is a week old.
